title: A Static for the Terminal
author: Sable Delacroix
blurb: Petra Okonkwo, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
